name: std-tactics-board-2d
description: 2D player-controlled grid-tactics board FRAME: composes grid-tactics (units authority) + fx-particles + round-flow + a player-intent/render trait onto one shared GameState with a canvas-2d render. Games consume this molecule and supply only theme/assets/units via config.

schema.description: 2D player-controlled grid-tactics board FRAME: composes grid-tactics (units authority) + fx-particles + round-flow + a player-intent/render trait onto one shared GameState with a canvas-2d render. Games consume this molecule and supply only theme/assets/units via config.
schema.name: std-tactics-board-2d

attackDamage.description: Health removed from a target per ATTACK intent
attackDamage.label: Attack Damage

gridHeight.description: Grid row count clamping move + AI bounds
gridHeight.label: Grid Height

gridWidth.description: Grid column count clamping move + AI bounds
gridWidth.label: Grid Width

running.description: When true, incoming MOVE/ATTACK/AI_TURN intents are applied; toggle to freeze the board
running.label: Running

tiles.description: Grid tiles used for passability checks during moves and AI stepping
tiles.label: Tiles

units.description: Seed unit roster (players and enemies) present before the first intent
units.label: Initial Units

emits.description: Hit particles produced by an attack or AI strike; a fx-particles listener spawns them
Live team survivor counts after this intent resolved; a round-flow listener decides win/lose

events.description: Hit particles produced by an attack or AI strike; a fx-particles listener spawns them
events.name: Burst

events.description: Live team survivor counts after this intent resolved; a round-flow listener decides win/lose
events.name: Units Changed

decayRate.description: Ttl units removed from every fx entry each tick; higher fades particles faster.
decayRate.label: Decay Rate

fx.description: Seed particles rendered before the first BURST; usually empty.
fx.label: Initial Fx

running.description: When true the decay tick runs; toggle to freeze effects.
running.label: Running

running.description: When true, incoming unit-count changes are evaluated for win/lose; toggle to freeze.
running.label: Running

emits.description: Called when the round resolves to a win or loss

events.description: Called when the round resolves to a win or loss
events.name: Game End

initialEnemies.description: Enemy count at start; the kill baseline so the first kill scores correctly.
initialEnemies.label: Initial Enemies

pointsPerKill.description: Points awarded for each enemy removed since the last signal.
pointsPerKill.label: Points Per Kill

running.description: When true, enemy-count drops award points; toggle to freeze scoring.
running.label: Running

frames.description: Atlas sub-texture names cycled into @entity.frameName, one per tick; empty disables name cycling.
frames.label: Frame names
frames.synonyms: sprite names, atlas frames, animation frames

seedArt.description: Initial kind → (state → draw-group items) catalog merged under bus-published entries (published entries win). Lets a board ship vector art with zero asset imports.
seedArt.label: Seed Art

emits.description: Asks mounted svg asset catalogs to (re)publish their states; also the collector's own seed re-apply hop

events.description: Asks mounted svg asset catalogs to (re)publish their states; also the collector's own seed re-apply hop
events.name: Svg Asset Sync

attackRange.description: Max manhattan distance a selected unit may strike an enemy.
attackRange.label: Attack Range

extraAddonEvent.description: Event name used by an `extraAddons` button's `action` literal (e.g. "PRODUCE"). Set this to the same value so the trait's own event set declares it.
extraAddonEvent.label: Extra Addon Event

extraAddons.description: Board-specific action buttons appended after End Turn/Cancel (e.g. Produce). The action names events listened by composed mechanic atoms.
extraAddons.label: Extra Addon Buttons

extraStats.description: Board-specific HUD stats appended after Result/Phase/Turn/Score (e.g. production, resources). Values may bind @entity fields owned by composed mechanic atoms.
extraStats.label: Extra HUD Stats

features.description: Decorative environment features drawn on the board.
features.label: Features

fxPresets.description: This board's effect vocabulary — one look/recipe row per fx type its mechanics emit; unknown types fall back to a neutral spark.
fxPresets.label: Fx Presets

movementRange.description: Max manhattan distance a selected unit may move.
movementRange.label: Movement Range

showMinimap.description: Whether the canvas draws a minimap.
showMinimap.label: Show Minimap

vectorUnitScale.description: Uniform scale applied to vector (svgAssetArt draw-group) units.
vectorUnitScale.label: Vector Unit Scale

emits.description: Player move intent applied by the grid-tactics authority
Player attack intent applied by the grid-tactics authority
Ends the player turn; the grid-tactics authority runs the enemy AI pipeline
Board-declared event name for the `extraAddons` action (e.g. Produce). Registers the call-site literal used inside `extraAddons` button descriptors in this trait's own event set.

events.description: Player move intent applied by the grid-tactics authority
events.name: Move

events.description: Player attack intent applied by the grid-tactics authority
events.name: Attack

events.description: Ends the player turn; the grid-tactics authority runs the enemy AI pipeline
events.name: Ai Turn

events.description: Board-declared event name for the `extraAddons` action (e.g. Produce). Registers the call-site literal used inside `extraAddons` button descriptors in this trait's own event set.
events.name: @config.extra addon event
